C0160.title: Game Streamer Profits 3 Million Yuan from Selling Cheats, Placed Under Criminal Coercive Measures
C0160.summary: In 2024, Shanghai police cracked a game cheating case. Well-known streamer Xue promoted DMA cheats with wallhack and auto-aim features during live broadcasts. He recruited agents through fan groups, selling cheat hardware and verification codes, accumulating over 3 million yuan in illegal profits. Sixteen suspects were placed under criminal coercive measures.
